title: Product
description: TOGAF-sourced representation archetype — a multi-representational concept aggregating features (Mechanisms) from multiple Structures, market interfaces, and portfolio context. Like BusinessProcess and ValueStream, a Product is a cross-structural representation — it defines a governed aggregate viewed from portfolio/catalog perspective. Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Product (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

productType.description: Product classification. TANGIBLE = physical product. DIGITAL = software/digital product. SERVICE = service offering. COMPOSITE = bundled product + service. TOGAF mapping: Product type classification.

lifecycle.description: Product lifecycle stage. TOGAF mapping: Product lifecycle management.
